name: race
description: Ancestries with culture, appearance, and suggested traits
entries: Ashborn — Charcoal-skinned descendants of wildfire spirits who build migratory glass cities. Suggested trait: endure extreme heat and sense nearby open flame.
Tidekin — Amphibious people with translucent fins whose floating clans follow moon-driven currents. Suggested trait: breathe underwater and gain +1 when navigating by water.
Stonehearts — Broad, mineral-skinned artisans who preserve memories in carved family pillars. Suggested trait: resist poison and gain +1 when examining stonework.
Mothfolk — Nocturnal, velvet-winged scholars drawn to light and forgotten knowledge. Suggested trait: glide short distances and see clearly in dim light.
Thornbloods — Plantlike wanderers who bloom according to emotion and exchange stories as seeds. Suggested trait: survive on sunlight and water, but suffer in severe cold.
Cloudstriders — Tall, hollow-boned nomads from mountain bridges who read weather as language. Suggested trait: ignore ordinary falling harm from short distances.
Mirrorborn — Reflective-eyed people whose appearance subtly echoes whoever stands nearby. Suggested trait: +1 when imitating mannerisms after careful observation.
Ember Dwarves — Compact volcanic smiths who treat every crafted object as a temporary ancestor. Suggested trait: resist heat and judge an item's workmanship by touch.
Hush Elves — Pale forest dwellers who cultivate silence and communicate with hand signs while hunting. Suggested trait: +1 to stealth when moving slowly.
Burrowlings — Rabbit-eared communal farmers famous for emergency tunnels and alarming hospitality. Suggested trait: exceptional hearing and rapid digging through soft ground.
Coralbound — Living reef people who add colorful fragments throughout life and host tiny symbiotic creatures. Suggested trait: water breathing and natural light armor.
Clocklings — Small constructed beings awakened when a master clock broke, each searching for a personal purpose. Suggested trait: no need to eat and precise internal timekeeping.
Dreamscarred — Humanoids altered by a shared ancestral nightmare, bearing moving birthmarks. Suggested trait: recognize illusions more easily but sleep unpredictably.
Frostmanes — Fur-covered northern clans whose songs encode maps across shifting ice. Suggested trait: cold resistance and +1 to endurance in snow.
Glimmer Goblins — Curious tunnel traders with luminous freckles and a culture built around clever reuse. Suggested trait: see underground and improvise simple tools from scrap.
Marshscale — Patient reptilian fishers who elect leaders through week-long debates. Suggested trait: hold breath for an hour and remain motionless with unusual ease.
Ravenfolk — Feathered collectors of promises who consider exact memory a sacred duty. Suggested trait: mimic a heard voice and gain +1 when recalling spoken details.
Ironveined — Former humans transformed by magical mines, with metal threading their skin. Suggested trait: sense worked metal nearby but attract lightning.
Dusk Giants — Gentle seven-foot nomads whose size diminishes in bright daylight. Suggested trait: increased carrying ability and darkvision.
Lantern Souls — Spirits housed in crafted bodies, with visible inner lights changing color by mood. Suggested trait: produce light and briefly leave the body to look nearby.
Fungal Kin — Colony beings grown around a shared core, trading memories through spores. Suggested trait: communicate simple emotions through nearby fungi.
Sandshapers — Desert people with flowing features who record history in glass sculptures. Suggested trait: tolerate heat and reshape their face slowly.
Wolven — Pack-oriented hunters who settle disputes through ritual races instead of violence. Suggested trait: track by scent and +1 when coordinating with an ally.
Starfallen — Rare luminous travelers descended from something that crashed centuries ago. Suggested trait: sense celestial direction and resist magical disorientation.
River Orcs — Powerful boat-building clans who value rescue, hospitality, and competitive poetry. Suggested trait: +1 to strength when hauling or rowing.
Echoes — Humanoids born in ancient ruins who occasionally repeat words spoken there long ago. Suggested trait: hear emotional traces in significant places.
Waxfolk — Sculptable people created by forgotten artisans who renew their features during festivals. Suggested trait: alter minor appearance details, but soften near intense heat.
Rooted — Bark-skinned guardians able to stand still for days while listening through soil. Suggested trait: sense heavy movement through the ground.
Moonclaws — Feline cliff-city inhabitants with ritualized curiosity and elaborate family debts. Suggested trait: exceptional balance and low-light vision.
Patchwork Folk — Descendants of magically fused refugees whose varied bodies celebrate adaptation. Suggested trait: choose one modest physical adaptation tied to ancestry.
